sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied naga-city-sports-complex.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. Hand re-traced on 2026-10-08 from the owner image at enlarged scale: every distinguishable crown, canopy belt, lawn, planted bed, garden plot, hedge, path, apron, court and parking area is traced where the image shows it, and bare ground stays bare. The running track is traced as the red oval band (outer and inner edges fitted to the image) and placed around the mapped soccer pitch, which sits about 10 m off the mapped courts relative to the image, with the dark-maroon infield segment inside its north bend, joined to the perimeter road by the pale dirt path on its east side; the mapped road runs closer to the track than the image's road, so the path is shortened to meet it. The light walkway along the grandstand front and the grey slab south-west of the courts are hardscape; the packed-soil concourse around the courts and the dry infield stay bare. Canopy outlines follow the forest north-west of the grandstand, the belt west of its south end, the forest between the access road and the track's north end, the belt between the track and the eastern perimeter road and the forest south of the track; crowns are packed inside each outline. The forest beyond the perimeter road and the pool area are left as they are. A second owner close-up of the pool and tennis courts (2026-10-08, matched to the main image on court and pool corners) extends the grounds north and east over the forest around the pool, the courts and both Naga River banks; canopy is packed inside traced outlines, palms dot the west pasture, and the dirt yard below the pool, the cleared lot north-west and the farmland stay open. Registration: continuous triangulated image registration; independent check errors 4.13 m, 6.45 m, 4.60 m, 6.08 m. Trunks sit inside their observed crowns; crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
